description.value:
Fighting requires more precision than some think. Less than an inch is the difference between a vital organ or a flesh wound. Fighters know that finishing what you’ve started takes numbers off the field, and when an opponent is low, it’s important to finish them off before they have the chance to punish your mistake.

As a reaction after injuring a creature on your turn, if the creature has less than ¼ hit points remaining, then the creature takes additional chaos damage equal to your overall level.

If this reaction reduces the creature to 0 hit points, you can take an additional Action this turn.

system.requirements: Must have the Fighter Starter Abilities
